story.title: Meesho Says 70% of Its Code Is Now AI-Written as Revenue Jumps 47% to Rs 3,531 Crore in Q4
story.summary: Indian e-commerce platform Meesho has disclosed that over 70% of its codebase is now generated using artificial intelligence, with more than three-quarters of its orders driven by an AI recommendation engine. The company posted a 47% revenue jump to Rs 3,531 crore in Q4 FY26, narrowing its net loss by 88% year-on-year to Rs 166 crore. CEO Vidit Aatrey framed AI not just as a productivity tool but as a core commercial engine powering Meesho's path to profitability.
